swaps.retire_text: Assertion (A): A current-carrying wire can deflect a compass needle placed beneath it, even without touching it. Reason (R): The magnetic field produced by the current can act through non-magnetic materials such as air and cardboard.

add.q: Assertion (A): A current-carrying wire can deflect a compass needle placed beneath it, even without touching it. Reason (R): The magnetic field produced by the current disappears only gradually after the current is switched off, taking several seconds to fade. Choose the correct option.
add.a: A is true, R is false
o: A is true, R is false
A is false, R is true
Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A

swaps.retire_text: Assertion (A): A coil without any iron nail inside it can still deflect a compass placed near its end. Reason (R): A current-carrying coil has a magnetic effect of its own, and an iron core only makes this effect stronger, it does not create it.

add.q: Assertion (A): A coil without any iron nail inside it can still deflect a compass placed near its end. Reason (R): The two ends of an electromagnet are found to have opposite polarity, one behaving as a north pole and the other as a south pole. Choose the correct option.
add.a: Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
o: Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is false, R is true
A is true, R is false
Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A

swaps.retire_text: Assertion (A): A lifting electromagnet left connected to its cell for a long time may become too weak to lift objects, even though it still feels warm. Reason (R): A cell that remains connected for a long time can weaken, reducing the current flowing through the electromagnet's coil.

add.q: Assertion (A): The strength of a lifting electromagnet does not depend on the current flowing through its coil, only on how long the crane operator keeps the switch closed. Reason (R): A cell that remains connected for a long time can weaken, reducing the current flowing through the electromagnet's coil. Choose the correct option.
add.a: A is false, R is true
o: A is false, R is true
A is true, R is false
Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
